stations.title: Theo
stations.say: The site must not show our costs.
stations.note: Every card has the cost on it.

stations.title: Shop site
stations.text: Names, sizes and prices, and no costs.

captions: The cards can be gone through now. Theo gets them ready for the shop's site.
Each card goes out whole, the cost of making the candle included.
You take cards apart and make new ones: tags, a monthly pick, copies, public cards.
The cedar card reaches the site with its name and price, and its cost stays home.
Objects and lists can be taken apart and put together again without changing them.
